hints: Focus on counting hydrogen atoms, not molecules, so look at the formula of each substance to see how many H atoms are in one molecule.
Pentane is $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{12}$ and but-2-ene is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$, so multiply moles by 12 and by 8 to get moles of H atoms for A and B.
Remember one $\text{H}_2$ molecule gives two H atoms, then compare all four amounts as moles of H atoms to spot the largest.
walkthrough:
**Write down what counts as H atoms**

Think molecule by molecule. One molecule can bring several H atoms with it.

$$\text{moles of H atoms} = \text{moles of substance} \times \text{H atoms per molecule}$$

**Calculate A and B**

Pentane is $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{12}$, so it has 12 H per molecule. But-2-ene is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$, so it has 8 H per molecule.

$$\text{A: } 0.10 \times 12 = 1.2 \text{ mol H atoms}$$
$$\text{B: } 0.20 \times 8 = 1.6 \text{ mol H atoms}$$

**Calculate C and D**

For C, each hydrogen molecule $\text{H}_2$ contains 2 H atoms. For D, use Avogadro's constant $L = 6.02 \times 10^{23}$.

$$\text{C: } 1.00 \times 2 = 2.00 \text{ mol H atoms}$$
$$\text{D: } 6.02 \times 10^{23} \text{ atoms} = 1.00 \text{ mol H atoms}$$

**Compare and conclude**

Now just line them up: 1.2, 1.6, 2.00, and 1.00 mol of H atoms. The 2.00 mol value is clearly the largest, so 1.00 mol of hydrogen molecules wins.

options.A: 0.10 mol of $\text{C}_5\text{H}_{12}$ gives $0.10 \times 12 = 1.2$ mol of H atoms. This is more than D but less than B and C, so it is not the largest.
options.B: 0.20 mol of $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8$ gives $0.20 \times 8 = 1.6$ mol of H atoms. This beats A and D, but it is still smaller than the 2.0 mol from option C.
options.C: 1.00 mol of $\text{H}_2$ molecules contains $1.00 \times 2 = 2.00$ mol of H atoms. This is larger than A (1.2 mol), B (1.6 mol) and D (1.0 mol), so it contains the largest number of hydrogen atoms.
options.D: $6.02 \times 10^{23}$ is exactly one mole ($L$), so this is only 1.00 mol of H atoms. Many students pick this because the big number looks impressive, but it is the smallest amount here.
